correctness.rationale: All-dimensional proof reconstructs the Euclidean regular-simplex embedding and power-distance sign w_i=-2b_i in side-length sqrt(2) normalization and w_i=-L^2b_i at edge length L. Normal-cone cell inequalities force the 2^d face-foot vertices and d paired facets. Dirichlet(1,...,1) conditional cross-sections give exact inclusion-exclusion polynomial; fixing a coordinate reduces the others to interval overlap, whose strict improvement under nontrivial balancing occurs on an explicitly positive-measure set. Finite differences and beta-integral evaluate both sharp boundary constants. Exact independent determinant-based rational flag-simplex volumes verified 137 cases in dimensions 2--6; 164 additional numerical checks. These finite checks supplement, not replace, proof.
